dialect.detail: IBM-style mainframe COBOL with RECORDING MODE F, COMP-3 packed decimal, and FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE; consistent with IBM Enterprise COBOL or similar mainframe environment

purpose.domain_detail: Account management financial report generation; reads account records and prints formatted financial report with account number, name, credit limit, and balance
purpose.summary: CBL0004 reads an account file (ACCTREC) and writes a formatted financial report to a print file (PRTLINE). It prints date-stamped headers and iterates through all account records, outputting account number, last name, credit limit, and balance with currency formatting.

notable_features: COMP-3 packed decimal for monetary fields (ACCT-LIMIT, ACCT-BALANCE)
Currency picture clause $$,$$$,$$9.99 for formatted monetary output
FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE for dynamic date stamping in report header
RECORDING MODE F on file descriptors
Structured use of FILLER with VALUE SPACES for output formatting
Inline comments explaining COBOL concepts (educational style)
verdict.notes: The extensive inline comments explaining basic COBOL concepts (FILLER, SPACES, PERFORM, etc.) and references to earlier programs like CBL0001.cobol strongly indicate this is part of a structured COBOL tutorial or course series. The program is well-structured but clearly pedagogical in nature.
